invoker.description: This is the reference document for the REST API and resources provided by SERVICE/WEB. The REST APIs are for developers who want to integrate SERVICE/WEB with other standalone or web applications and for administrators who want to script interactions with the SERVICE/WEB server. ## Additional information * [How to specify dates und times](/rest/doc/ex-doc.html#date-and-time) (e.g. energy/{value}/{type}?start=EUROPEAN_01.01.2022&end=NAMED_Today) * [Content negotiation (XML/JSON)](/rest/doc/ex-doc.html#content-negotiation)
